records.observation: Thread stores stream/prefix/textarea and plain nonvolatile isRunning=true. stopRunning only sets false: no interrupt/stream close/join or synchronization. run wraps stream in default-charset InputStreamReader/BufferedReader, while flag then blocking readLine!=null appends newline+prefix+ >+line directly to AdvancingTextArea from reader thread; previous class also moves caret with no EDT handoff. No flag recheck between readLine and append, stop cannot itself unblock read, visibility unguaranteed. No stream/reader close even EOF/error; catches IOException only and prints stacktrace, runtime UI/null failures uncaught. No line/output memory cap or drain guarantee. Two process streams can append independently and finish marker ordering is not guaranteed.

records.observation: Constructor optional text field initializes shared static DecimalFormat from NumberFormat.getInstance cast, pattern #,###,###,##0.0,18columns/right alignment; optional progressbar min0max100. Files null, lengths0. initialize stores both files, text0KB, progress0 and snapshots infile.length ONLY when bar exists; no input existence/nonzero/type or output validation. action always reads outfile.length even with neither UI component; displays bytes/1024 KB and sets progress to int((max-min)*outputLength/inputLength+min), not consumed input or conversion success. Zero input produces NaN or infinity in double, narrowed int0 or maxint; no explicit guard/clamp before bar setter. Output size can exceed input and progress can move backwards if output truncates. Missing-file length0 indistinguishable here. finish simply sets bar100 even on error if caller invokes it, does not refresh output text/length or inspect process status. No EDT scheduling or synchronization; static formatter overwritten by later constructor, normal Timer caller thread to be connected. No file writes.

records.observation: Extends previously read SwingWorker. Constructor stores container/textarea, Timer500ms null listener,initial delay0/coalescetrue; process and reader refs null, process_istatus implicitly0. initialize stores command array reference without copy, replaces timer listener, appends command display; Runtime.exec(String[]) occurs in initialize caller thread BEFORE construct, no shell introduced by this class and no custom environment/cwd. Creates Error/Output reader threads but does not start yet, THEN status MIN_INT, THEN container.initializeWaiting. Throwable catch only exec/readertasks/status/callback range prints generic UI message+stacktrace and returns normally, no cleanup or failure state. Logging/array setup outside catch. Thus exec failure before status sentinel leaves default0 and isEndedNormally true; partial setup can leak live process until finished, callbackfailure leaves sentinel. Caller start/abort behavior pending panel. construct starts each nonnull reader, starts timer, waits process.waitFor, stores returned status; catches Throwable including interruption/null process/thread-start failures, prints and returns null normally. Parent SwingWorker can consequently schedule finished even after caught failure. finished stops timer, sets reader flags false and discards refs WITHOUT join/drain/close, destroys process if nonnull then nulls it, logs current exit status and calls container.finalizeWaiting regardless of success. Buffered tail output may be dropped, concurrent late output can follow end marker; plain reader stop flag visibility not guaranteed. No try/finally around cleanup, destroy/UI/callback failure can skip remainder. isEndedNormally only status==0, no liveness/started/completion test; before initialize also true. No override interrupt: inherited interrupt wakes worker wait but doesn't directly destroy child; eventual finished owns destroy if scheduling/callback succeeds. No output artifact validation, process-tree kill or explicit child stdin close. Reader UI updates occur off EDT, finished normally parent-dispatched EDT. Archived executable never run during audit.
